steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Cover a baking sheet with aluminum foil and grease with cooking spray. Grease a sheet of aluminum foil; set aside.
Mix ground beef and onion soup mix together in a large skillet; cook and stir over medium-high heat until beef is crumbly and evenly browned, 5 to 7 minutes. Drain and discard any excess grease.
Remove the skillet from heat; stir in Cheddar cheese and mayonnaise.
Place roll bottoms on the prepared baking sheet. Spread beef mixture onto each bottom; cover with bread roll tops. Cover sliders with the prepared sheet of aluminum foil.
Bake in the preheated oven until burger sliders are heated through and cheese is melted, about 30 minutes.
Serve sliders with sliced pickles and enjoy!

raw_recipe.headline: Burger Sliders
raw_recipe.description: These burger sliders are made with a savory blend of ground beef and cheese baked on rolls to make fun-size mini burgers perfect for game day.

video.description: Savory meat and sweet buns makes this the perfect slider to bring to a party or gathering!

review.reviewBody: Hi all... I submitted this recipe - just to clarify, I use two packages of the King Hawaiian Sweet dinner rolls (in the orange bag, remove the cardboard tray it comes in). You can just slice the tops off all at once and spread the beef mixture on the "bottoms". Make sure to spray the foil with Pam so they don't stick. I also don't put them on a cookie sheet, just wrap the whole thing in foil and pop in the oven, this prevents the bottoms from burning against the hot cookie sheet and keeps the buns soft. Make sure to drain the grease and let the beef mixture cool a bit before adding mayo and cheese so it doesn't separate and get too oily. These are always the hit of the party! Tastes just like White Castles!

Great advice to just cook these wrapped in foil and of course drain the beef and cool before adding the cheese and mayo and using 1/2 to 3/4 of the onion mix ! The only addition I made to the recipe that continues to result in men and women asking for my recipe is: I add a special butter sauce to the top, borrowed from another great recipe. Here it is: 2 tbsp minced onion flakes, 1 tbsp worchestershire sauce, 1 tbsp Dijon or Spicey Mustard (not the regular yellow), 1/2 cup melted butter. You melt these together and brush ontop of the buns just before you put in the oven to bake. The men who have eaten this, always ask for the recipe!

I've been making this recipe for years. Best ever!! The only thing I do differently is assemble the burgers, spray tops with butter flavored cooking spray, sprinkle a little garlic powder on top and wrap individually in foil and put them in the oven. I get people placing orders they love them so much.

These were so yummy and easy. I love that these aren't made with patties, yet they totally hold up in the little buns. Don't be afraid of the mayo; it really isn't overpowering and lends a richness to the meat mixture. I did use cookin4therapy's bun sauce, though I used less and wish I would have have slathered it on (especially on the insides of the bun). Fantastic recipe and so happy to have found it! It will be perfect to bring to a party! Bun sauce: 2 tbsp minced onion flakes, 1 tbsp worcestershire sauce, 1 tbsp Dijon or Spicy Mustard (not the regular yellow), 1/2 cup melted butter. You melt these together and brush on top of the buns just before you put in the oven to bake.

This recipe is good as is, but I kicked it up a couple of notches. I added an onion to the ground beef. I added 2T of Ketchup and 1T of mustard to the mayonnaise. After I put them together I melted a quarter cup of butter and brushed it over the tops of the rolls and then sprinkled sesame seeds over the tops of the rolls. Everything else I did according to the recipe. I will definitely make again.

I added a 1/2 tsp of garlic powder to the meat mixture as well as 1/3c of mayo. Flattened out on a baking sheet and baked for 10min. Added chopped onions and baked for 10 more min then added cheese slices and baked for 5 more min. Placed meat patty on bottom buns added top then baked for 5 more min.

I brought these to a football watch party and what a hit!! They were amazing! Easy to make and delicious. I was hesitant on using the mayo because a couple of people wouldn't eat it if they knew but they loved it! I followed the recipe except only cooked them for 20 mins in the oven and like another reviewer mentioned did not use a cookie sheet. The foil was plenty strong enough to hold them. Also, I used parchment paper to make them easier to remove. Definitely will be making these again!

HELPFUL TIP FOR ONION HATERS and those who don't want HARD buns: Really was kind of concerned my four kids would hate this because of the onion flavor. All of them despise onions, and you know what... I guess in this packet, it's not a standout because all of mine didn't say a thing. I noticed...but loved it! The only complaint they had was it needed more flavor in terms of ketchup and more pickles ...and the grownups wanted shredded lettuce and a tomato option. ……….BUT for a quick teenager snack that you can even make ahead and leave in a dish ready to just heat for 30 min, this definitely fits the bill. Also, was afraid of the 2lbs of ground beef.... I mean, that's a lot! ...but it really did well with 2 packs of king rolls. Sure there were leftovers, but it is worth eating again. I used enough buns that I thought the kids would eat. Foiled a 13X9 dish, and also covered with foil. W/O it, the buns would have been rocks. Also must cool ground beef as mentioned before adding the shredded cheese and mayo. Drain the beef too. All these made just the perfect burgers.

I have been making this recipe for years and it is always a hit. For my latest endeavor I substituted the ground beef with Beyond Burger patties, as one of our party was vegetarian. I also did not have onion soup mix, so I substituted with a little garlic powder, dash of liquid smoke, a couple tsp of Worcester sauce, and diced onions cooked with the burgers which were broken up. I have to say they turned out terrifically and were a hit. I also use the butter/poppy seed/mustard et al topping mentioned in some other reviews. I would highly recommend using the Beyond Burger product as an alternative and healthier meat source for this recipe.
Putting the buns in the oven, makes the bread tough to eat, and even burns it.

Husband loves these. I love how easy they are to make. Since it is just the two of us, I cut the recipe in half. I cook the 2 pounds ground beef with the soup mix, and freeze half. I make up the sliders with the other portion using 1/2 of the ingredients listed. When we need a quick supper, all I have to do is defrost the ground meat, and finish the prep. Don't scrimp on the pickles!
The whole family loved this!! We definitely be in our rotation.
Love this.

Sliders are a personal favorite of mine. I buy slider buns and use them for every day use, my sandwiches or anything. One of my personal favorites is just plain mayonnaise sliced cucumbers shredded cheese with the fried onions on top 😋. Now I can add these burger Sliders to my favorites 😍
I use 1 lb of Velvetta to 2 lbs of ground beef and don't use mayo. Crowd favorite without question
I substituted lean ground Turkey and Spanish onion as well as cheddar cheese and olive oil mayo as a much healthier option. I am sure that this will be a weekly dinner favourite.
These were a hit at my Super Bowl party. The only thing I did differently was follow a couple of earlier reviewer tweaks and added mustard and Worcestershire to taste.
I love how quick and easy this recipe is! I will definitely make this again!

These are simple to make and something a little different. This is a loose meat sandwich with cheese to hold it together. It does have a flavor similar to a White Castle burger even though the texture is not. I used a blend of American and cheddar cheese as all cheddar can be too oily and it doesn't melt as well as American cheese does. These could have used more onion flavor. It's there, but using that dehydrated onion doesn't bring the same brightness and bite that fresh onion does. These are filling and eat more like a meal than an appetizer. I only ate two of them. I'd probably fix these again. They were easy, tasty, and a cheeseburger without being the same old boring burger patty on a bun.
Very good
